Dungeon cards on the Overworld. Top right, live counters of enemies, elites and players. K opens a detailed summary: quests, aurum, respawn and a route line to the exit, the aurum, an elite or a quest target. Assign your own key below.

Our fonts across the game's interface: menus, chat, journal, books, inventory, trade and the classic windows. Gabin for ordinary text, Greengoth for headings, Hangyaku for books; the special fonts of sigils, sets and legendary powers stay. Works apart from the translation and the item cards.

The pack as a list of item rows: two columns when opened alone, one column beside a chest, wagon or body; a button brings the square icons back. Enchanted pieces live on their base's page and the Magic page is gone; Ingredients hold only what recipes spend, the rest goes to the new Junk page, which you set up yourself. Sorted by quality when the pack opens and after your actions; identical pieces stack in one cell; quest letters are locked on receipt.

One two-column card: the material apart from the armor type, properties and effects as lists, the game's own sigils, sets and a comparison with what you wear. At the bottom, the item's description and its worth with saved improvements. No inner scrolling. For the game's enhanced interface.
Marks for taverns, shops, guilds and other venues on the Overworld. A detailed town map helps you find the place you need. “Only visited” hides the buildings you have not been to yet.

Enemy drops and items on the floor in one window with filters, presets, sorting and “Take all”. Autoloot is set up separately. Walls and other floors are left out; items are taken from their original piles and bodies.
Translates the interface, items, quests and books into Russian. Place names stay as they are where the map needs them for search.
